title: Letter 37
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letters of St. Jerome > Letter 37

notes.text: Marcella had asked Jerome to lend her a copy of a commentary by Rhetitius, bishop of Augustodunum (Autun), on the Song of Songs. He now refuses to do so on the ground that the work abounds with errors, of which the two following are samples: (1) Rhetitius identifies Tharshish with Tarsus, and (2) he supposes that Uphaz (in the phrase gold of Uphaz) is the same as Cephas. Written at Rome A.D. 384.
